channel.title: The Graham Norton Show
channel.desc: Together on Graham's sofa tonight: Hollywood comedy greats Jack Black and Paul Rudd, together at last in horror meta-reboot Anaconda; Jessie Buckley, talking about playing William Shakespeare's wife Agnes in the tragic drama Hamnet; and actress and comedian Michelle de Swarte, writer and star of hit BBC sitcom Spent.
